implementation: InitialEditorSession constructs one EnvironmentCurveTemporaries owner for four current curve objects before initial dispatch. EnvironmentPage.curves aliases those exact objects through const shared pointers; no independent curve owner is manufactured during composed fill.

Original initial copy slots copy four environment curves, then step curve, then view-factor state. Backed-up refresh copies the same environment objects before fill, then restores SC without replacing page pointers or undoing callback writes to owners.

ACVCOF fill chooses variable radio from3/12/1, otherwise constant for ndim0 or the retained ENVATM ndim boolean for nonzero ndim. The callback writes currentCurveIndex3, live var, and owner var. Selection0 changes only live ndim0; it never writes temporary ndim at fill.

Recognized nonzero variable with ndim0 remains a table-radio branch and Save copies its raw constant member, without g6 conversion. Ordinary ncomp1 fallback collapse retains counts/arrays at callback, then original copy/restore produces retained positive count metadata with null arrays.

Nonconstant ACVCOF requires explicit valid owners, distinct from live SC curves and from one another. Composed Apply refuses replaced owner references before any effects. Existing isolated no-owner constant profile remains source-compatible.
Multicomponent fallback-to-constant collapse remains explicitly unsupported, along with unknown allocation/borrowed layouts and owned nested curves. Public editor300 refusal remains.
